payload.text: ISSUE:0306 (vc decision 120, hv's ruling read 2026-11-01 06:51Z by date -u): write_errors_file's red seal written to a temp file beside the seal, held to RED IS NEVER EMPTY there, then renamed over the seal, so no seal reader sees an empty seal, which seal_state reads as green, across a red run's close (the remedy the issue names); an arm reading the seal from a second process across a red run's close sees red or in flight, never green. After WP16 and before the cut; critic-shell before its first run; lib/runlog is in no bank, so its run fills any lane gap.
